transport: stdio (FastMCP), called from Claude Code as mcp__campus-customs-ops__<tool>
verification_method: Each tool output was checked with read-only sqlite3 queries (URI file:data/campus_customs_new.db?mode=ro).

tests.prompt: Give me information for Classic Bulldog Tee in medium.

db_check.sql: SELECT i.sku, i.name, i.size, i.qty, i.location, p.list_price, p.unit_cost FROM inventory i JOIN pricing p ON p.sku = i.sku WHERE i.sku = 'CC-TEE-WHITE' AND i.size = 'M';
db_check.notes: qty 5, Aisle B, list price $28 match. margin_per_unit 20 = 28 - 8.

tests.prompt: Which vendor should I use to order more t-shirts?

db_check.sql: SELECT id, name, specialty, lead_days, date((SELECT date_today FROM desk), '+' || lead_days || ' days') AS ready_if_ordered_today FROM vendors WHERE specialty LIKE '%apparel%';
db_check.notes: Only apparel vendor is 1 Bulldog Print Co, 5 lead days; 2026-08-31 + 5 days = 2026-09-05.

tests.prompt: Are there any outstanding payments as of today?
tests.arguments_note: days_ahead left at its default of 30.

sql: SELECT id, vendor_id, amount, due_date, status, description FROM invoices WHERE status <> 'paid';
SELECT id, landlord, space_name, monthly_rent, next_due FROM leases;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS payment_rows FROM payments;
SELECT name, balance, date FROM cash_accounts;
db_check.notes: Payments table is empty, so invoice 501 (open, due 2026-08-28, 3 days overdue) and lease 1 rent (due 2026-09-02) are both unpaid. 840 + 2400 = 3240 owed vs 3400 in checking, leaving 160.
